input.title: Treatment induces a strong interferon-stimulated gene response

block.title: Treatment shifts 610 genes, and the canonical interferon genes lead

content.prose: Treatment changes the expression of 610 genes at an adjusted p-value under 0.05, with 408 up-regulated and 202 down-regulated. The strongest signal belongs to three canonical interferon-stimulated genes, ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1, which is what points to an interferon response. The evidence is a single differential-expression run with three replicates per group, and no pathway enrichment was run, so the interferon label rests on those three genes.

block.title: The volcano plot shows a broad, two-sided response

content.prose: In the volcano plot, each point is a gene, with fold change on the x axis and adjusted p-value on the y axis. Up-regulated genes spread to the right and down-regulated genes to the left, and the response is roughly symmetric in reach, with fold changes up to about 3 in log2 units in both directions. The table holds only genes that already passed the significance filter, so every point sits past both guide lines and the plot shows no non-significant background. It shows the shape of the hit list, not how the hits compare with the genes that did not change.

blocks.title: Differential expression, treated versus control
blocks.caption: Each point is one gene from the filtered differential-expression table. Guide lines mark adjusted p = 0.05 and an absolute log2 fold change of 1. The ten most significant genes are labeled.

block.title: ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1 are the only annotated hits, and they are the most significant

content.prose: Of the 610 hits, only three carry a gene symbol: ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1. The rest are uncharacterised loci. The three are canonical interferon-stimulated genes and sit at the top of the significance ranking, with fold changes of 1.1, 1.47 and 1.84 in log2 units. The table below ranks the top rows by adjusted p-value. Their p-values are about 1e-38, and the later rows in the ranking are near-ties, so the order within this group should not be read as meaningful. Nothing here tests whether interferon-related genes are enriched overall.

blocks.title: Most significant genes
blocks.caption: Top 10 genes by adjusted p-value. The top three are the annotated interferon-stimulated genes.

content.prose: The table lists the genes with the smallest adjusted p-values. ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1 lead it, with log2 fold changes of 1.1, 1.47 and 1.84. content.prose: The evidence supports a treatment-associated shift in expression that includes interferon-stimulated genes. It does not show the mechanism, and no pathway enrichment test was run, so the interferon label rests on the named genes alone.

input.title: Treatment induces an interferon-stimulated gene signature: 610 genes at FDR 0.05

block.title: Treatment shifts 610 genes, and the three canonical interferon genes are among the most significant

content.prose: The question is how treatment changes gene expression, and whether the change looks like an interferon response. Differential expression gives 610 genes below an FDR of 0.05, most of them up-regulated, and the canonical interferon-stimulated genes ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1 are all in the set. Their fold changes are moderate, not the 3 to 4 log2 range that the run synthesis quotes. The evidence rests on three replicates per group, so the signature is a strong lead and not a mechanism.

block.title: The volcano plot shows an up-weighted response with large effects on both sides

content.prose: In the volcano plot below, each point is a gene, with the log2 fold change on the x axis and the adjusted p-value on the y axis. More genes sit on the right (up with treatment) than on the left (down), and the guide lines mark an adjusted p of 0.05 and an absolute log2 fold change of 1. The results table holds only genes that already passed FDR 0.05, so the plot has no non-significant background cloud. It shows the shape of the hit list, not how the hits stand against the whole transcriptome.

blocks.title: Differential expression after treatment
blocks.caption: Volcano plot of the 610 genes below FDR 0.05. The ten most significant genes are labelled.

block.title: ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1 are the most significant genes, with moderate fold changes

content.prose: Three canonical interferon-stimulated genes are in the hit list and sit at the top of the significance ranking. Their fold changes are moderate, between about 1 and 2 log2 units. The run synthesis states 3.1 to 4.0, but the largest fold change in the table is 3.09 and it belongs to an unannotated gene, so that statement does not match the data and this report does not use it.
ISG15 is up-regulated with a log2 fold change of 1.1 at the lowest adjusted p-value in the table.
MX1 is up-regulated with a log2 fold change of about 1.5.
IFIT1 is up-regulated with a log2 fold change of about 1.8.

Almost all of the other 607 genes carry placeholder LOC symbols, so the table gives no way to test whether the wider set is enriched for interferon biology. The interferon label rests on these three genes, which is a reasonable lead and not an enrichment result.

block.title: Three replicates per group and one low-depth sample limit how far this result goes

content.prose: The result is exploratory evidence of an interferon signature, and it should be read with the following limits.

items: Each group has three replicates, so the dispersion estimates and the adjusted p-values are fragile.
Sample C3 has a low library size, as the run synthesis records. This analysis did not test how much it changes the result.
The results table holds only the 610 genes below FDR 0.05, so the number of genes tested and the background distribution are not available here.

The up and down counts in this report (408 and 202) come from the results table, and the run synthesis quotes 412 and 198. The table is used here, and the difference should be checked against the run.
No pathway or enrichment analysis was run, so the interferon label rests on three named genes.

content.prose: The smallest next step is to check the sample C3 effect by repeating the differential expression without it. After that, run an enrichment test against an interferon-response gene set, using the full list of tested genes with their annotated symbols.

const md = `# Treatment effect on gene expression: the interferon response

## Summary

Treatment changes the expression of 610 genes at FDR 0.05 (DESeq2, three treated against three control samples): 408 up and 202 down. The three genes in the table that carry a recognised symbol, ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1, are canonical interferon-stimulated genes and all rise (log2 fold change 1.10, 1.47 and 1.84). That is the evidence for an interferon response. It rests on three genes, because the other 607 genes carry only placeholder symbols (LOC...) and no pathway or signature test was run.

## Methods

DESeq2 on the counts of six samples, treated against control, three replicates for each group. Significance threshold: adjusted p below 0.05. The table analysed is de_results.csv (gene_id, symbol, log2FoldChange, padj).

## Interferon response

The volcano plot shows the 610 genes in the results table. Red points are up in treated samples (408) and blue points are down (202). The fold changes span -3.09 to 3.09, and the largest adjusted p is 9.4e-9, so every gene in the table is significant.

![Volcano plot of the treatment response](report-sessions/thread-r/derived/volcano.svg)

| Gene | log2 fold change | Adjusted p |
|---|---|---|
| ISG15 | 1.10 | 1.0e-38 |
| MX1 | 1.47 | 1.1e-38 |
| IFIT1 | 1.84 | 1.3e-38 |

## Limitations

- Three replicates for each group, so power is limited and the fold-change estimates are imprecise.
- The analysis synthesis notes a low library size for sample C3. I did not check this against the counts, and I did not test its effect on the result.
- The results table holds significant genes only, so the volcano plot has no non-significant background.
- Only three of 610 genes have a recognised symbol. The interferon label rests on those three. A gene-set or signature test on the full results would test it properly, and none was run.
- The run synthesis and the figure caption on the page state 412 up and 198 down, and log2 fold changes of 3.1 to 4.0 for ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1. The results table gives 408 up, 202 down, and 1.10 to 1.84. This PDF uses the table values. The source of the difference is not resolved.
`;

input.code:
const md=`# Treatment effect on gene expression: the interferon response

## Summary

Treated samples differ from control at 610 genes (FDR < 0.05): 408 up and 202 down. Interferon-stimulated genes are up, but the evidence for an interferon response is thin. Only three of the 610 genes carry canonical interferon-stimulated gene symbols (ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1), and all three are up. The other 607 carry placeholder LOC symbols, and no pathway analysis was run. This supports "known interferon-stimulated genes are induced". It does not support "the interferon response is the dominant effect of treatment".

## Methods

DESeq2 on the counts of six samples, treated against control, three replicates for each group. Significance is the adjusted p-value (FDR) below 0.05.

## Interferon response

The three canonical interferon-stimulated genes in the results are all up, with log2 fold changes of 1.10 (ISG15), 1.47 (MX1) and 1.84 (IFIT1), and adjusted p-values near 1e-38.

![Volcano plot](report-sessions/thread-r/derived/volcano.svg)

*Volcano plot of the 610 genes in the results table, all below FDR 0.05. Up: 408. Down: 202. The three labelled genes are ISG15, MX1 and IFIT1. The table holds significant genes only, so no non-significant genes appear.*

Across all 610 genes, the effects are symmetric and large. The median log2 fold change is 2.09 among up genes and -2.09 among down genes, and every gene has an absolute log2 fold change above 1 (range -3.09 to 3.09).

## Limitations

- Three replicates per group. Dispersion estimates are imprecise and the result is sensitive to a single outlying sample. No sample-level QC (PCA, sample distances) is in the evidence I read.
- The results table is already filtered to significant genes (610 rows, all FDR < 0.05, all absolute log2 fold change above 1). The unfiltered background is missing, so I cannot give the fraction of genes that changed, and I cannot run enrichment against a proper background.
- 607 of 610 genes have LOC placeholder symbols. Without annotation I cannot say how many are interferon-related. An interferon-stimulated-gene set test (for example against the Hallmark interferon alpha and gamma sets) is the smallest next analysis that would settle the angle.
- Adjusted p-values reach about 1e-38 with three replicates per group. These values are very small for that sample size, and I would check the model and the filtering before treating them as precise.
- Association only. The data do not show which interferon signalling (type I or II) is involved, or whether it is a direct effect of the treatment.
`;
const r=await tools.export_pdf({markdown:md,name:"interferon-response-report",title:"Treatment effect on gene expression: the interferon response"});
console.log(JSON.stringify(r));

const md = `# Effect of the treatment on gene expression: the interferon response

## Summary

Treatment changes the expression of 610 genes at FDR 0.05 (408 up, 202 down; three treated and three control samples). Three canonical interferon-stimulated genes (ISG15, MX1, IFIT1) are among the up-regulated genes, which is consistent with an interferon response. The evidence for that response is thin, however: the result table holds no other well-known interferon-stimulated gene, 607 of the 610 gene symbols are unannotated placeholders (LOC identifiers), and no pathway enrichment test was run. Read the interferon response as a hypothesis that three genes support, not as an established conclusion.

## Methods

DESeq2 on the counts of six samples, treated against control, three replicates for each group. The result table (de_results.csv) lists gene, symbol, log2 fold change and adjusted p-value.

## Interferon response

![Volcano plot of significant genes](report-sessions/thread-r/derived/volcano-de.svg)

The result table holds only genes with an adjusted p-value below 0.05 (largest value 9.4e-9), so the plot shows no non-significant genes. Of the 610 genes, 408 are up and 202 are down.

| Gene | log2 fold change | Adjusted p-value |
|---|---|---|
| ISG15 | 1.10 | 1.0e-38 |
| MX1 | 1.47 | 1.1e-38 |
| IFIT1 | 1.84 | 1.3e-38 |

These three genes are modest in effect size next to the largest changes in the table (about 3.1 in either direction), and those largest changes belong to unannotated LOC genes. The run synthesis reports a log2 fold change of 3.1 to 4.0 for these three genes and counts of 412 up and 198 down; neither matches the result table, and this document uses the table values.

## Limitations

- Three replicates for each group, so the power is limited and the dispersion estimates are uncertain.
